name: TLCTC SonarQube
description: Translates SonarQube SAST findings into TLCTC v2.1 cluster exposure. A Python CLI sidecar that pulls issues via the SonarQube Web API (self-hosted or SonarCloud), joins them against the canonical 987-entry CWE->TLCTC mapping, applies R-ROLE context-aware logic for ambiguous mappings, and emits JSON / Markdown / SARIF reports. Read-only by default; opt-in write-back via `tlctc-0N` tags. Includes a zero-Python declarative starter (tag import, quality profile, dashboard).
author: TLCTC Project
